response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack and systems software engineer with strong C/C++ and Linux background, but the resume shows no evidence of native Japanese proficiency, no embedded Linux kernel source modification experience, no networking/switch/security protocol work (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP), and his recent career trajectory is firmly in web/TypeScript/product engineering rather than embedded security firmware.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple languages including C/C++
Demonstrated Linux systems familiarity and low-level programming (DLang, C++, embedded audio project)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and technical leadership (staff/senior roles)
concerns: No indication of Japanese language skills, which is a hard requirement
No experience with LAN-switch/networking security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF, SNMP, Ansible)
No recent or demonstrated Linux kernel source-code investigation/modification experience
